name: KutilXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Groovebox of Bastl-style modules patched with touch cables across three screens: Wave Bard on Bastl's open-source Kastle 2 DSP plus Kompas, Crust 2, Pizza, Alchemist, Basil and ABC. Patch by touching jack-group windows and pressing CONNECT; a preset window holds 36 factory patches and 16 user slots with multi-tag filtering. MPC OS 3.x.
